name: smoke-mv-inverter
description: Harness acceptance test: two-rail plumbing + a thick-oxide (nfet_06v0/pfet_06v0) inverter. Not a design deliverable.
claim: None — harness self-verification, not a spec claim. Proves the two-rail PVT plumbing (parameter substitution on both vlogic and vdrv, .lib corner sections reaching the thick-oxide 06v0 device family, .temp) actually takes effect, so later records against ratified spec lines (spec/gate-driver.md) can be trusted.

vdiv_ratio.description: ideal divider is exactly vlogic/2 -- proves vlogic_val plumbing and measurement parsing

vout_ratio.description: thick-oxide inverter output pulled to vdrv through the PMOS -- proves vdrv_val plumbing on the 06v0 device family

vbias_drv.description: diode-connected nfet_06v0 Vgs at fixed current; the spread floor proves .lib/.temp actually reach the 06v0 device family, not just 03v3
